scenes.say: The shortest war in history lasted just thirty eight minutes.
August twenty fifth, 1896. The sultan of Zanzibar, an island off East Africa, suddenly dies.
Within hours, his cousin Khalid seizes the palace and declares himself the new sultan. Britain wants someone else.
British warships surround the palace. Their message: get out by nine o'clock on the morning of August twenty seventh.
Khalid refuses. At two minutes past nine, the British ships open fire.
Zanzibar's only warship fires back. It is sunk almost at once.
By nine forty, the palace is burning, about five hundred defenders are dead or wounded, and the flag comes down.
The British side had just one sailor wounded. And Khalid? He ran to the German consulate to hide.
